I still can't make this subtask pass, and I'm not going to fake it. The blocker is the test file, not the implementation.

`test_format_value_null_is_blank` requires `format_value(None) == ""`. `test_format_value` requires `format_value(None) == "NULL"`. `test_format_result_select_table` requires a `NULL` cell in the rendered output. No implementation satisfies all three. Making the blank test pass would break the other two and contradict your spec.

The only way I could turn it green is a trick, such as a string subclass that equals both `""` and `"NULL"`. That would pass the validator without the code being correct, so I won't do it. Editing `tests/test_cli.py` is also off-limits to me, even though it is listed in my files.

The quickest fix is on your side. Someone with write access to the test file should delete `test_format_value_null_is_blank`, the last test in `tests/test_cli.py`. It looks like a stray addition. After that the suite is 13 of 13 with no change to `minidb/cli.py`.

If you want blank to be the real behavior, say so. I'd then change `format_value`, and the spec plus the two `NULL` tests would need updating to match.
